verdict.rationale: Adyen documents its own reveal-card-details iOS SDK, which lets cardholders see their PAN, CVC and expiry date in the app. That is the core hosted reveal flow this story asks for. However, the evidence never states that the flow keeps the developer out of PCI scope or SAQ D, and it shows no ephemeral-key mechanism or coverage beyond iOS. Missing for 10: vendor documentation that the reveal flow removes PCI DSS/SAQ D scope, details of the ephemeral-key or encryption flow, web/Android equivalents, and independent corroboration.
